shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical stone surface
a horizontal register or row of repeated figures
repeated similar forms aligned along a band
justification: Both surfaces are low reliefs organised into horizontal registers with figures repeated in profile, but the content differs entirely: A shows schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like reptile, arcs/crescent-like forms) with no humans, while B shows a procession of naturalistic bearded human figures in long robes and headgear, holding hands and carrying objects. The only correspondence — profile figures in a row on a carved panel — is a generic convention any relief tradition could produce independently.
